name: Quinn Yorick
summary: At the Ivar Patch, Quinn Yorick hides from the ghoul that wounded him. The Forsaken scout waits in a ruined farmhouse, unable to finish his mission or retreat alone.

sections.title: A Precarious Refuge
sections.body: Quinn Yorick lies gravely injured upstairs in a ruined farmhouse at the Ivar Patch. Ivar the Foul, a ghoul lurking in the farm’s barn in northern Silverpine Forest, wounded him in a vicious clash. Quinn and his sister Rane were sent to scout Silverpine and report to High Executor Hadrec. Too hurt to finish the mission or make a safe retreat alone, he remains in hiding. Passing travelers working for the Forsaken bring him healing and deal with the creature that nearly tore him apart.

faq.answer: Quinn Yorick hides on the upper floor of a ruined farmhouse in the Ivar Patch, north of the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.
Ivar the Foul, a ghoul lurking in the farm’s barn, severely wounded Quinn Yorick.

faq.q: What role does Quinn serve for Horde adventurers?
faq.answer: Quinn’s sister, the Deathstalker Rane Yorick, sends travelers to bring him a healing potion. After he takes it, she asks them to kill Ivar the Foul so Quinn has time to recover.

angles.text: As an Undead, Quinn’s plight shows the danger ghouls and beasts pose to Forsaken forces trying to secure northern Silverpine.
